summary: Mrs. Alouf discusses the significance of names and identity in the book of Shemot, focusing on how the tribes of Israel maintained their Hebrew identity while enslaved in Egypt. She explores the meaning of Hashem's names as revealed to Moshe Rabbenu and explains how these names provide hope and purpose during times of suffering and exile.
questions: Why does the Torah repeat the names of the tribes when they were already known?
What is the significance of the different names of Hashem?
How can a person maintain their identity and hope during times of suffering?
Why is the book of Shemot called Sefer Hasheni?
